title: Read a remote evidence file
responsibility: Accept supported remote evidence bytes only when their stated size and hash match the requested file.

inputs.name: remoteArtifact.value
inputs.description: Base64 content with media type, byte length and SHA-256 hash.

inputs.name: remoteArtifact.asked
inputs.description: Required hash of the requested file; undefined is refused.

outputs.name: artifactMediaTypes
outputs.description: Exact allowed media types for PNG, JPEG, WAV, MPEG audio, MP4 audio, Ogg audio, JSON and UTF-8 plain text.

outputs.name: unshownArtifact
outputs.description: Message explaining that this kind of file cannot be shown.

outputs.name: largeArtifact
outputs.description: Message explaining that the file exceeds the size limit.

outputs.name: otherArtifact
outputs.description: Message explaining that the response is not the requested file.

outputs.name: remoteArtifact
outputs.description: Decoded bytes with their media type and verified SHA-256 hash.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects unsupported types, oversized files, absent or mismatched requested hashes, unreadable base64 or mismatched decoded length or hash.
